issue_context.title: fresh open of excalidraw doesn't render correct font in Firefox
issue_context.body:
Tried on latest Chrome/Safari

https://excalidraw.com/?id=6309590945759232

If I click anywhere or refresh the page it renders the correct font
comments:
This is because the preload html tag is using the public folder but the css is going through the build pipeline and stored on a cdn. They don't match anymore.

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41676054/how-to-add-fonts-to-create-react-app-based-projects

I'll try to fix it.
Grrrr, when deployed in production, the css gets rewritten :(

Okay, so the issue is that netlify added a smart layer on-top. It rewrites the css and the font paths inside, but not the link preload.

On `now`, the css is not rewritten https://excalidraw.now.sh/
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/197597/73587937-e764c180-44b9-11ea-8d9f-81268fdc1944.png)

On netlify, the css is rewritten but not the link preload:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/197597/73587943-01060900-44ba-11ea-8eac-4f735bed7925.png)

This means that we're no longer preloading the same font and why we have a "flash of unstyled content".

@sdras, what is the best way to make a bug report to netlify html rewriting such that it also rewrites link preload?

Okay, I found a ticket on netlify support group ( https://community.netlify.com/t/asset-optimization-preloading-fonts/3197/8 ) that says that there are no plans to fix it. But it's possible to disable the optimization in the settings (@lipis can you do it? or give me access to the account?)

> We don’t have any plans to update this behavior at present, so you should choose one or the other (asset optimization or preloading) for best results on netlify.
I'll remove the optimizations.. and they never got back to me for extra admins.. bugging them again

I can still repro this on Firefox. The correct font doesn't render until the shape is invalidated.

Steps:

1. open **new tab** and load excalidraw (either a backend link, or let it load from localStorage)

![firefox_bad_font](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5153846/76708894-ce773f00-66fa-11ea-950d-111d760edb88.gif)
I see this sometimes on Safari too.
